quote: Whenever any vehicle is stopped at a marked crosswalk or at any unmarked crosswalk at an intersection to permit a pedestrian to cross the roadway, the driver of any other vehicle approaching from the rear shall not overtake and pass such stopped vehicle.

activation.condition: A vehicle is stopped at a marked crosswalk or an unmarked crosswalk at an intersection to permit pedestrian crossing; another driver approaches from the rear.

obligation.description: The rear-approaching driver shall not overtake and pass the stopped vehicle.

timing.description: Observe lead stopped state, rear approach and complete passage in original frame order.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Actual road intersection, sidewalk lateral lines and curb or traveled-edge definition need original source review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: to permit a pedestrian to cross the roadway
judgment_calls_needed.note: Lead stop purpose needs an independent original source; pedestrian movement alone cannot prove purpose.
Original actor body history and road direction must establish the relative approach.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: overtake and pass such stopped vehicle
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original full body sequence must establish passage while the lead remains stopped; no numerical legal cutoff is supplied.

parameter_refs.range_or_domain: source-marked or source-defined unmarked intersection crosswalk

parameter_refs.name: ego_behavior
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: wait or pass request, measured afterward

parameter_refs.name: lead_stop_purpose
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: independently sourced pedestrian-permitting or other purpose
